1. Baixe o arquivo uwmadison.sqlite3. Conecte-se a ele usando o pacote RSQLite, armazenando a conexão em uma variável conn.

```{r}
setwd("C:/Users/jvald/Downloads/ME315")

library(RSQLite)
library(DBI)

conn <- dbConnect(SQLite(),"uwmadison.sqlite3")
dbListTables(conn)
```

2. Quem são e quantos são os professores que lecionaram disciplinas cujo tópico era estatística (subjects.abbreviation='STAT');
```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT instructors.id) AS quantidade
FROM subjects
JOIN subject_memberships
    ON subjects.code = subject_memberships.subject_code
JOIN course_offerings
    ON subject_memberships.course_offering_uuid = course_offerings.uuid
JOIN sections
    ON course_offerings.uuid = sections.course_offering_uuid
JOIN teachings
    ON sections.uuid = teachings.section_uuid
JOIN instructors
    ON teachings.instructor_id = instructors.id
WHERE subjects.abbreviation = 'STAT'")
```

3. O GPA americano é definido numa escala de 0 a 4, em que A = 4, AB = 3.5, B = 3, BC = 2.5, C = 2, D = 1 e F = 0. Determinando a nota média de cada oferecimento pela ponderação da quantidade de alunos em cada extrato com os valores numéricos de cada conceito, indique (no que se referente a disciplinas no assunto de estatística):


```{r}
professores <- dbGetQuery(conn, "
SELECT instructors.name, AVG((4*gd.a_count + 3.5*gd.ab_count + 3*gd.b_count + 2.5*gd.bc_count + 2*gd.c_count +gd.d_count)/(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count) ) AS gpa_medio

FROM grade_distributions AS gd 
JOIN subject_memberships AS sm ON gd.course_offering_uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
JOIN subjects AS s ON sm.subject_code = s.code
JOIN sections ON gd.course_offering_uuid = sections.course_offering_uuid
AND gd.section_number = sections.number
JOIN teachings ON sections.uuid = teachings.section_uuid
JOIN instructors ON teachings.instructor_id = instructors.id
WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
GROUP BY instructors.id, instructors.name
ORDER BY gpa_medio")
head(professores)
```

```{r}
dbWriteTable(conn, "professores", professores, temporary = TRUE)
```

Quem é o professor mais difícil?
```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT name, gpa_medio
FROM professores
WHERE gpa_medio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gpa_medio
LIMIT 1")
```

Quem é o professor mais fácil?
```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT name, gpa_medio
FROM professores
WHERE gpa_medio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gpa_medio DESC
LIMIT 1")
```

```{r}
disciplinas <- dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT courses.number, courses.name, AVG(( 4*gd.a_count + 3.5*gd.ab_count + 3*gd.b_count + 2.5*gd.bc_count + 2*gd.c_count + gd.d_count)/(gd.a_count + gd.ab_count + gd.b_count + gd.bc_count + gd.c_count + gd.d_count + gd.f_count)) AS gpa_medio
FROM grade_distributions AS gd
JOIN subject_memberships AS sm
ON gd.course_offering_uuid = sm.course_offering_uuid
JOIN subjects AS s 
ON sm.subject_code = s.code
JOIN course_offerings
ON gd.course_offering_uuid = course_offerings.uuid
JOIN courses
ON course_offerings.course_uuid = courses.uuid
WHERE s.abbreviation = 'STAT'
GROUP BY courses.uuid, courses.number, courses.name
ORDER BY gpa_medio")
head(disciplinas)
```
```{r}
dbWriteTable(conn, "disciplinas", disciplinas, temporary = TRUE)
```

Qual é a disciplina mais difícil?
```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT name, gpa_medio
FROM disciplinas
WHERE gpa_medio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gpa_medio
LIMIT 1")
```

Qual é a disciplina mais fácil?
```{r}
dbGetQuery(conn, "SELECT name, gpa_medio
FROM disciplinas
WHERE gpa_medio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY gpa_medio DESC
LIMIT 1")
```
